case_title: QUANTUM ASSOCIATES VS ARCHE TECHNOLOGIES ATTN JOE KUA PRESIDENT

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,082.00 FILED BY QUANTUM ASSOCIATES AS TO DEFENDANT ARCHE TECHNOLOGIES ATTN JOE KUA PRESIDENT ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-08-1991 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 02
SUBSTITUTED PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT ARCHE TECHNOLOGIES ATTN JOE KUA PRESIDENT

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF QUANTUM ASSOCIATES IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT ARCHE TECHNOLOGIES ATTN JOE KUA PRESIDENT SEE ATTACHED FOR DETAILS STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
